nodes.definition: Define audience, niche, pillar topics, and platform priorities that constrain every downstream automation and distribution decision.
Build a recurring publication calendar that allocates pillars, formats, and cadence across platforms over a rolling horizon.
Batch-produce assets by grouping like tasks (filming, editing, writing) into focused sessions to cut context-switching cost.
Maintain reusable templates (thumbnails, intros, caption skeletons, graphic frames) that standardize look and speed production.
Convert one core asset into many platform-native derivatives (clips, threads, carousels, shorts) via a defined transformation pipeline.
Organize a digital asset management system with naming, tagging, and versioning so any asset is findable and reusable.
Configure scheduling tools to queue and auto-publish posts at planned times across platforms from a single source.
Wire no-code/low-code automations (triggers, webhooks, integration platforms) that move data and assets between tools without manual steps.
Use AI for ideation, drafting, captioning, editing, and transcription with human review gates to protect quality and voice.
Design a per-platform distribution strategy matching format, timing, and native conventions rather than identical cross-posting.
Model how each platform's ranking signals (watch time, saves, shares) reward content and adapt formats to fit them.
Plan collaborations, guest swaps, and creator partnerships to access new audiences and share distribution leverage.
Instrument platforms and links with consistent metrics, UTMs, and dashboards so performance is measurable and comparable.
Turn performance data into next-cycle content decisions via a structured review that feeds the calendar and strategy.
Run the sponsorship process: prospecting, rate cards, briefs, deliverables, and FTC-compliant disclosure.
Develop creator-owned products (courses, digital goods, services) packaged from expertise and validated against demand.
Operate recurring revenue (memberships, subscriptions) with tiered benefits, retention mechanics, and churn management.
Balance the revenue portfolio across sponsorships, products, memberships, and platform payouts to reduce single-source dependence.
Run repeatable acquisition tactics (hooks, SEO, discovery optimization, lead capture) that grow and convert audience over time.
Sustain audience relationships through replies, community spaces, and engagement rituals that deepen loyalty and signal value to platforms.
Govern the operation: disclosure rules, licensing, platform ToS, brand safety, and account-recovery contingencies.
